mission: Talon finds Iressa by baiting an old private debt-marker through a legitimate records-correction channel. Ben and Talon interrupt Iressa during an ordinary workday at Civitas Archive Systems, a respectable civic-records restoration and compliance firm. Iressa is now a former GAG Manifest Integrity Analyst: she knows duplicate manifests, quarantine classifications, restricted transfer corrections, and the difference between clerical damage and deliberate concealment. She denies knowing Talon before proving she does, moves them away from coworkers/security/cameras, charges a “Jedi complication fee,” lies about her exits, and changes the amount Talon owes her every time she mentions it. Civitas office beat: Give Iressa one coworker or ordinary office-life interaction before the old world swallows her day: someone calls her by her clean professional name, reminds her about a meeting, complains about a shared report, or asks whether she is still coming to lunch. Iressa lies smoothly to protect that person from Ben/Talon and from the trouble following them. Civitas lunchroom beat: While Iressa manages the disruption, Ben briefly waits in an employee lunchroom / visitor break area. An ordinary Civitas employee notices that he looks familiar but cannot immediately place him. Ben is polite but awkward, bracing for recognition as Luke’s son, Mara’s son, Jacen/Caedus’s survivor, the former GAG boy, or a Jedi from the war years. Instead, he is pulled into painfully normal small talk. The employee offers him half a sandwich — “you look like one of those guys who forgets to eat” — and asks if he works in compliance. Ben takes the food, answers vaguely, feels ridiculous standing there with a murder clue in his pocket while making office-real small talk about caf and record migrations.
why_now: Chapter 12 occupies the response phase and carries the next locked outline turn.
conflict: Make Iressa fun, competent, selfish, unexpectedly decent, and visibly invested in the fragile normal life she has built. Make Ben young and human in the lunchroom beat without making him socially helpless.
turning_point: Iressa recognizes the fragment as a cloned shipment identity under quarantine/survey disguise, not a simple duplicate.
closing_hook: Iressa recognizes the fragment as a cloned shipment identity under quarantine/survey disguise, not a simple duplicate.
setting: Coruscant, Civitas Archive Systems — a respectable civic-records restoration and compliance firm occupying the fourteenth through sixteenth floors of an aging commercial tower. Civitas is where Iressa Vossk works under a clean professional identity. The reception area has muted grays and blues, a Sullustan receptionist, badge-readers on inner doors. Iressa's office is at the end of a hall lined with cubicles; her nameplate reads IRESSA VOSSK, SENIOR RECORDS RESTORATION ANALYST. An employee lunchroom is two doors down (Ben waits there during a beat).
emotional_trajectory: Make Iressa fun, competent, selfish, unexpectedly decent, and visibly invested in the fragile normal life she has built. Make Ben young and human in the lunchroom beat without making him socially helpless.
